back_translation: I lifted up my eyes again and looked, and behold, a flying scroll.
The angel asked me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.”

Then he said to me, “This is the curse going out over the face of the whole land; for, according to one side, every thief will be swept away, and according to the other side, everyone who swears falsely will be swept away.

“I will send it out,” declares the LORD of Hosts, “and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of the one who swears falsely by My name. It will lodge in his house and consume it completely, both its timber and its stones.”
Then the angel who was speaking with me came out and said to me, “Now lift up your eyes and see what is coming forth.”
I asked, “What is it?” He answered, “This is the ephah basket that is going forth.” Then he said, “This is their iniquity throughout all the land.”
And behold, a lead cover was lifted, and there was a woman sitting inside the ephah.
He said, “This is Wickedness,” and he thrust her down into the ephah and pushed the lead cover over its mouth.
Then I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, two women came out with the wind in their wings; their wings were like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah between earth and heaven.
So I asked the angel who was speaking with me, “Where are they taking the ephah?”
He answered me, “To the land of Shinar, to build a house for it; and when it is prepared, it will be set there on its pedestal.”
